textbookText: 1. A bus travels 1 of a distance at 10 km/h, another 1 of the distance at 20 km/h and the
remaining 1rd of the distance at 60 km/h. What is the average speed of the bus?
2. The velocity of a particle at an instant is 10 ms-1. After 5 s the velocity of the
particle is 20 ms-1. What is the velocity at 3 s before reaching 10 ms-1?
3. A particle experiences constant acceleration for 20 seconds after starting from rest. If
it travels a distance S1 in the first 10 s and a distance S2 in the next 10 seconds, which one is the correct alternative?
4. The displacement of a particle is proportional to the first power of time. What is the acceleration of the particle? a. Small finite value b. zero c. infinite d. large finite value
5. What is the motion of the tip of the minute hand of a clock? a. zero displacement b. zero distance c. average speed is zero d. average velocity is non- zero
6. A bullet fired onto a wooden block loses half of its velocity after penetrating 40 cm. What further distance does it cover before coming to rest? a. 4000/3 m b. 2200/3 m c. 2200/5 m d. 2000/3 m
7. A cyclist moving on a circular track of radius 25m completes half a revolution in 25 s. What is its average velocity? a. 4 ms-1

b. 2ms-1 c. zero d. π ms-1 8. Two railway tracks extend parallel from north to south. If train A moves from north to south at 54 km/h and train B moves at 90 km/h from south to north. The relative velocity of the train A w.r. to the train B is a. 20 ms-1 b. 30 ms-1 c. 40 ms-1 d. 50 ms-1 9. _______________ is the simplest type of motion and is along a straight line path. a) plane motion b) rectilinear motion c) curvilinear motion d) circular motion 10. A train covers 90 miles between 1 p.m. and 4 p.m. How fast was it going at 2 p.m? a) 90 mph b) 30 mph c) 40 mph d) 80 mph 11. A police officer living on a planet with no air resistance drops a pair of handcuffs and a handkerchief from the same height at the same time. Which one will reach the ground first? a. the handkerchief b. handcuffs c. The answer depends on how far above the ground they were when he dropped
them. d. They both hit the ground at the same time.
